## Purpose

Describe the problem or use case. Link related issues, if any.

## Changes

Explain the resulting behavior, including a before/after example when useful.
Call out breaking changes and any migration steps.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. Explain any checks you could not run.

## Checklist

Mark each applicable item complete; explain any that do not apply.

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior, including a regression test for bug fixes.
- [ ] Relevant test, coverage, type, and lint checks pass.
- [ ] Documentation reflects any changed behavior.
- [ ] User-visible changes have a release note in `releasenotes/notes/`.
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits.
